name: lx1
description: Same design as lm1 (5-rung ladder x 3 escape hatches, both server envs) with large models: claude-opus-5-5 ($4/$20) and gpt-6-astra ($10/$50). Claude per-call budget cap $10 so the cap never truncates a run. Reps raised 2 -> 6 on 2026-11-18 (r3-r6 run on boomhauer). Opus split_secret stays at r1-r2: the API safeguard degrades ~80% of those runs (see ladder doc).
